climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Virginia and West Virginia AVA of 2.4 million acres in the valley between the Blue Ridge Mountains and the Appalachian and Allegheny Plateaus. It was Virginia's first AVA, and had about 116 acres of vines when it was created.
